metadata.title_si: වී වගාවේ ඒකාබද්ධ පළිබෝධ පාලනය කාල සටහන
metadata.title_en: Integrated Pest Management Calendar for Paddy Cultivation
metadata.publisher: Department of Agriculture (DOA) Sri Lanka & Asian Food & Agriculture Cooperation Initiative (AFACI)

authors.advisory: Dr. Rohan Wijekoon (Director General of Agriculture)
authors.technical_content: M.U.P. Jayasundara (Assistant Director of Agriculture - Development, Plant Protection Service)
authors.climate_data: Dr. B.V. Punyawardena (Agroclimatologist, Natural Resources Management Centre - NRMC)
authors.compilation: Chamara Hilmy Silva (Agricultural Instructor, Information & Communication Centre)

methods: Use certified high quality clean seed paddy
Maintain optimal plant density and synchronized planting
Balanced fertilizer application based on Leaf Color Chart (LCC)

ipm_core_principles.principle_en: Conserve and protect beneficial organisms (natural enemies)
methods: Plant flowering pulses/legumes on bunds to provide nectar and habitat for parasitic wasps
Do not burn rice stubble; leave small straw piles on bunds for spiders and predatory bugs
Apply spot treatments only when economic thresholds are breached

ipm_core_principles.principle_si: සතිපතා වගා සුපරීක්ෂාව හා නඩත්තු පිළිබඳ තීරණ ගැනීම
ipm_core_principles.principle_en: Weekly crop surveillance and informed management decision-making
methods: Scout fields weekly inspecting base of hills, leaves, and water surface
Count pest and predator ratios before deciding on control actions

stages.weather: Inter-monsoonal showers transitioning to Maha rains
cultural_management: Do not burn stubble (ඉපනැල්ල ගිනි නොතැබීම)
Maintain small straw heaps on bunds (නියරේ තැනින් තැන කුඩා පිදුරු ගොඩවල් තැබීම)
Incorporate straw into paddy soil (කුඹුරට පිදුරු යෙදීම)
Proper water control (ජල පාලනය)
Trim and clean only bund sides (නියර දෙපස පමණක් රැඳීම)
Deep land preparation and fine leveling of liyaddas (ගැඹුරට බිම් සකස් කිරීම / ලියැදි හොදින් මට්ටම් කිරීම)
Apply organic manure (කාබනික පොහොර යෙදීම)
Maintain optimum plant population (නිසි පැළ ගහනයක් පවත්වා ගැනීම)
Balanced fertilizer application (සමතුලිත පොහොර)
Controlled water management (ජල පාලනය)
Maintain balanced plant nutrition
Continuous field inspection for weed and pest hot-spots
Water depth regulation
Top-dress nitrogen based on Leaf Color Chart (පත්‍ර වර්ණ දර්ශකය භාවිතා කර පොහොර යෙදීම)
Strict water depth control (ජල පාලනය)
Intensive pest and natural enemy surveillance (පළිබෝධ සුපරීක්ෂාව)

stages.weather: Dry, sunny days with cool nights
cultural_management: Maintain 2-5 cm standing water until milky stage
Avoid high nitrogen fertilization
Monitor hopper populations at the base of stems
Maintain field drainage 10-14 days prior to harvest
Protect developing grain heads from sucking insects during milky stage
Do not burn stubble (ඉපනැල්ල ගිනි නොතැබීම)
Small straw heaps on bunds (නියරේ තැනින් තැන කුඩා පිදුරු ගොඩවල් තැබීම)
Apply straw into soil (කුඹුරට පිදුරු යෙදීම)
Leveling and bund maintenance (නියර දෙපස පමණක් රැඳීම / ලියැදි හොදින් මට්ටම් කිරීම)

stages.weather: Inter-monsoonal thunderstorms transitioning to Southwest monsoon
cultural_management: Maintain correct seedling population (නිසි පැළ ගහනයක් පවත්වා ගැනීම)
Balanced basal fertilizer (සමතුලිත පොහොර)
Water control (ජල පාලනය)
Monitor plant canopy for leaf folder damage
Avoid excessive nitrogen
Use Leaf Color Chart (LCC) for top-dressing urea (පත්‍ර වර්ණ දර්ශකය භාවිතා කර පොහොර යෙදීම)
Water management (ජල පාලනය)
Field surveillance for hoppers at stem base (පළිබෝධ සුපරීක්ෂාව)

stages.weather: Dry, warm, sunny weather with gusty winds in Dry Zone
cultural_management: Maintain 2-5 cm standing water until milky stage
Monitor hopper populations at the base of stems
Maintain field drainage before harvesting
Protect developing grain heads during milky stage

diagnostic_symptoms: Sucks plant sap from the base of tillers causing hopperburn (drying in circular patches like scorched fire)

monitoring_thresholds.vegetative_stage: Drain water and dry field if > 5 hoppers per hill (වර්ධන අවධියේ පඳුරක කීඩෑවන් 5 කට වැඩි නම් මුලින් ජලය කපා හැර කුඹුර වියළීම)
monitoring_thresholds.reproductive_stage: Drain water and dry field if hopper population exceeds threshold (ප්‍රජනක අවධියේ පඳුරක ඇටවට වඩා කීඩෑවන් වැඩි නම් ජලය කපාහැර කුඹුර වියළීම)

management_actions: Synchronized planting across the entire tract/yaya (කන්නයට යාය එකට වගා කිරීම)
Maintain optimal plant spacing and avoid excessive density (ප්‍රශස්ත පැළ ගහනය පවත්වා ගැනීම)
Apply balanced fertilizer; avoid excess nitrogen (සමතුලිත පොහොර භාවිතය)
Begin intensive field monitoring from 2 weeks after planting (සති දෙකේ පමණ සිට හානි කරන බැවින් වගා සුපරීක්ෂාව)
Drain standing water to dry out the soil surface when hoppers appear
Avoid indiscriminate prophylactic insecticide sprays which destroy natural predators (mirid bugs and spiders)

target_pests.damage_severity: High (Economic damage during milky grain stage)
diagnostic_symptoms: Nymphs and adults suck milky sap from developing rice grains, causing empty, spotted, or chaffy grains (discolored brown-black spots)

monitoring_thresholds.milky_stage: Apply recommended insecticide if > 2 bugs per square meter (වර්ග මීටරයකට මකුණන් දෙකකට වැඩි නම් නිර්දේශිත කෘමිනාශක යෙදීම)

management_actions: Clear all flowering weeds and grasses from bunds and surroundings before flowering (නියර වල සහ වගාවේ වල් පැළෑටි වල මල් ඉවත් කිරීම)
Physical trapping: hand-net or enclose bugs among leaf sheaths during early morning (ගොයම් මකුණන් කොලපුව අතර සිර කිරීම)
Food attractant baits: hang putrid rotting fish or animal offal baits in field corners to lure and trap bugs (ඉවත දමන මාළු කුඹුරේ තැනින් තැන එල්ලීම)
Spot application of recommended contact insecticide if threshold is exceeded

diagnostic_symptoms: Larva folds leaf blade longitudinally with silk and scrapes green mesophyll from within, causing transparent white longitudinal streaks

monitoring_thresholds.early_stages: Assess predator-to-pest ratio before treatment; spray only if natural enemy control fails

management_actions: Thorough weeding at crop establishment (වගාව ආරම්භයේදී වල්පැලෑටි ඉවත් කිරීම)
Apply only recommended nitrogen quantities; do not overuse urea (නිර්දේශිත නයිට්‍රජන් පොහොර ප්‍රමාණය යෙදීම)
Mechanical control: use thorny branches or drag a rope/stick across canopy to unroll folded leaves and expose larvae to sunlight and predators (ඉපලක ආධාරයෙන් හැකිලිලා කොළ දිග හැරීම)
Clip and bury heavily infested leaf tips (හානිකළ කොටස් කපා බඩට යට කිරීම)
Caution: excessive pesticide spraying induces severe secondary Brown Planthopper outbreaks (අධික ලෙස පළිබෝධනාශක යෙදූ විට දුඹුරු පැළ කීඩෑ හානිය ඇතිවිය හැක)
Apply spot spraying only where damage is concentrated (ස්ථානීය කෘමිනාශක යෙදීම)

diagnostic_symptoms: Maggot feeds on apical growing point causing the leaf sheath to transform into an elongated hollow pale-green or silvery tube resembling an onion leaf ('silver shoot' or 'onion shoot' / ගොක් කොළ)

monitoring_thresholds.nursery_and_tillering: Inspect seedlings and tillers early in wet season

management_actions: Cultivate strictly synchronized with seasonal rains (කන්නයට අනුව වගා කිරීම)
Maintain recommended plant spacing and density (නිවැරදි පැළ ගහනය පවත්වාගැනීම)
Avoid excess urea application during vegetative phase (වැඩිපුර යූරියා භාවිතා නොකිරීම)

diagnostic_symptoms: Nymphs and adults lacerate plant tissues and suck sap from tender leaves, causing leaf tips to curl inward, dry up, and develop a scorched appearance

monitoring_thresholds.seedling_stage: Apply chemical insecticide only if > 50% of leaves on seedlings are rolled (පැළැටියක පත්‍ර 50% රෝල් වී ඇත්නම් පමණක් කෘමිනාශක යෙදීම)

management_actions: Timely planting according to season (කන්නයට වගා කිරීම)
If planting is delayed, monitor closely and take rapid counter-measures (කන්නයට පමා වී නම් තීර ප්‍රතිසාර කිරීම)
Cultural water control: flood the liyaddas completely to submerge seedlings for 24-48 hours and disturb water surface to drown thrips (ලියැදි වල ජලය පුරවා සොලවා හැරීම)
Chemical spray only when the 50% leaf rolling threshold is breached

diagnostic_symptoms: Caterpillar bores into stem base causing deadheart (වියළි ගොබය) during vegetative stage and whitehead (හිස් බොල් කරල්) during reproductive stage

monitoring_thresholds.threshold: Inspect for egg masses covered with buff-colored hairs and deadhearts

management_actions: Plow and bury stubble deeply under soil during land preparation (ඉපනැල්ල පසට යටවන සේ බිම් සකස් කිරීම)
Apply recommended nitrogen rates; avoid excess nitrogen (නිර්දේශිත නයිට්‍රජන් පොහොර ප්‍රමාණය යෙදීම)
Under standard balanced cultivation, it is generally kept under check by egg parasitoids and natural predators (බරපතල හානි කරන පළිබෝධකයෙකු නොවේ)

target_pests.damage_severity: High (Direct crop destruction, bund burrowing, zoonotic disease)
diagnostic_symptoms: Cuts tillers diagonally near water level and hoards panicles inside bund burrows; burrows destabilize liyaddas causing water loss
management_actions: Major pest damaging liyaddas and crop bunds (වගාව අසල ලියැදි වලට හානිකරන ප්‍රධාන පළිබෝධකයෙකි)
Strict caution required as rats are primary vectors of leptospirosis / rat fever (මී උණ පැතිරීමට දායක වන නිසා වඩා සැලකිලිමත් විය යුතුය)
Implement a coordinated, synchronized community-wide integrated management approach across adjacent fields (වෙල් මියන් මර්ධනය සඳහා ඒකාබද්ධ ප්‍රවේශයක් අවශ්‍ය වේ)
Narrow field bunds (reduce width to < 30 cm) to eliminate burrowing sites
Clean bund vegetation and employ mechanical rat traps

diagnostic_symptoms: Microscopic mites live inside leaf sheaths sucking sap; lesions show brown necrotic chocolate-colored spots inside sheath; panicles emerge sterile or partially filled with discolored grains

monitoring_thresholds.threshold: Check inside leaf sheaths of boot-leaf stage plants

management_actions: Damage can range from localized patches to entire fields (වගාවේ සුළු වශයෙන් හෝ සම්පූර්ණ වශයෙන් හානිය පැවතිය හැක)
Early symptoms are hidden inside leaf sheaths, making detection difficult until damage is severe (කොපු මයිටා හානිය මුලින් හඳුනාගත නොහැකි නිසා හානිය බරපතල විය හැක)
Burn infected stubble or plow deep to bury stubble completely (ආසාදිත වගාවක ඉපනැල්ල පිළිස්සීම හා පස පෙරළීම මගින් ඉපනැල්ල පසට යට කිරීම)
Practice crop rotation wherever possible (හැකි අවස්ථාවලදී බෝග මාරුව)

Seed sanitation: sun-dry seeds thoroughly in hot sunlight and store in dark cool dry conditions prior to soaking to prevent seed transmission (කොපු මයිටා හානිය බීජ මගින් පැතිරීම වැළැක්වීමට බීජ දියෙහි දැමීමට දිනකට පෙර අව්වේ ඉතා හොදින් වියළා අඳුරුව තැබීම වඩාත් සුදුසු වේ)

diagnostic_symptoms: Mites feed on upper leaf surfaces producing white/yellow specks; foliage eventually shows pronounced chlorotic yellowing (පත්‍ර කහ වීම පත්‍ර මයිටා හානියේ මූලික ලක්ෂණය වේ)

monitoring_thresholds.threshold: Inspect leaf canopy during dry spells

management_actions: Yellowing of foliage is primary symptom
Maintain appropriate water levels; avoid moisture stress
Protect predatory phytoseiid mites by avoiding broad-spectrum chemical sprays

diagnostic_symptoms.leaf_blast: Spindle-shaped or eye-shaped lesions with grey/whitish centers and reddish-brown borders (පත්‍ර මත දැකිය හැකි ලක්ෂණ)
diagnostic_symptoms.collar_rot: Brownish lesion at junction of leaf blade and sheath causing leaf drop (පත්‍ර සන්ධියේ දැකිය හැකි ලක්ෂණ)
diagnostic_symptoms.node_blast: Blackish-brown necrosis at stem nodes causing culm breakage (පර්ව සන්ධියේ දැකිය හැකි ලක්ෂණ)
diagnostic_symptoms.neck_blast: Dark necrotic lesion at panicle base causing whitehead or unfilled drooping panicle (කරල් බෙල්ලෙහි දැකිය හැකි ලක්ෂණ)

target_diseases.favorable_conditions: Warm and humid/wet weather conditions (තෙත් උණුසුම් කාලගුණය)
management_actions: Widely prevalent fungal disease affecting multiple plant parts (බහුලවම දැකිය හැකි දිලීර රෝගයයි)
Inspect leaves early and adopt rapid control measures upon initial symptom sighting (මූලිකව පත්‍ර වලට වැළඳෙන බැවින් පරික්ෂාකාරීව සිට රෝග ලක්ෂණ දුටු වහාම මර්දන පියවර අනුගමනය කිරීම ඉතා වැදගත්ය)
Maintain optimal plant spacing and avoid dense planting (නිවැරදි පැළ ගහනය පවත්වා ගැනීම)
Balanced fertilizer application; strictly avoid excessive nitrogen application (සමතුලිත පොහොර භාවිතය)

diagnostic_symptoms: Greyish oval or elliptical lesions with brown irregular margins on leaf sheaths just above water line (පත්‍ර කොපු මත අළුපාට ඕවලාකාර ලප ඇති වීම විශේෂ ලක්ෂණයයි)
In severe infections, lesions coalesce up the culm giving the entire hill a scorched appearance as if burned by fire (ආසාදනය තදබල වූ විට ගින්නෙන් පිළිස්සීමක් මෙන් දැකිය හැක)
target_diseases.favorable_conditions: Appears predominantly after maximum tillering stage in dense, high-humidity, high-nitrogen canopies (උපරිම පඳුරු දැමීමේ අවස්ථාවට පසුව ඇති වේ)
management_actions: Prevalent fungal disease in both irrigated and rainfed systems (මෙයද බහුලව දැකිය හැකි දිලීර රෝගයයි)
Maintain correct plant population and spacing to improve aeration (නිවැරදි පැළ ගහනය පවත්වා ගැනීම)
Apply balanced fertilizers and avoid split nitrogen over-application (සමතුලිත පොහොර භාවිතය)

diagnostic_symptoms: Affects both young seedlings (kresek wilt phase) and mature plants (ළපටි ගොයමට මෙන්ම පරිණත ගොයමට ද සෑදේ)
Infected stem and leaf base emit a distinctive strong foul odor (ආසාදිත ශාකයක කඳ කොටසෙන් අධික දුර්ගන්ධයක් හමීම විශේෂ ලක්ෂණයයි)
Water-soaked lesions on leaf margins enlarge, turn yellow-orange, and dry to straw color (ආසාදනය උග්‍ර වූ විට පත්‍ර කහ පැහැ වී වියළී යයි)
target_diseases.favorable_conditions: Strong winds, high rainfall, standing floodwaters, and high temperatures
management_actions: Maintain optimal plant spacing and density (නිවැරදි පැළ ගහනය පවත්වා ගැනීම)
Balanced fertilizer application; withhold additional urea when symptoms appear (සමතුලිත පොහොර භාවිතය)
Strict water regulation: drain water from infected liyaddas to prevent bacterial spread via water flow (ජල පාලනය)

predators.ecological_niche: Ground and basal stem predator active during morning and day
predators.prey: Planthoppers, leafhoppers, stem borer moths, fallen larvae

predators.ecological_niche: Active day-hunting predator across mid to upper plant canopy
Canopy and soil surface active predator
predators.prey: Rice leaf folder caterpillars, planthopper nymphs, small larvae

predators.ecological_niche: Larvae and adults roam upper canopy and stems
predators.prey: Planthopper eggs and nymphs, thrips, mites (larva is particularly voracious)

predators.ecological_niche: Specialized hopper predator in rice canopy
predators.prey: Pierces and sucks eggs and young nymphs of brown and white-backed planthoppers

predators.ecological_niche: Aquatic water surface predator in paddy fields
predators.prey: Fallen planthopper nymphs, hopper adults, mosquito larvae

predators.ecological_niche: Low-altitude flyers hunting within crop canopy
Aerial predators patrolling above crop canopy
predators.prey: Flying leaf folder moths, stem borer moths, adult planthoppers

parasitoids.target_pest_stage: Parasitizes stem borer caterpillars inside stems
parasitoids.conservation_practice: Plant flowering legumes on field bunds to provide nectar for adult wasps (නියර මත රනිල බෝග වැවීමෙන් බඹර විශේෂ වර්ධනයට උපකාරීවේ)

parasitoids.target_pest_stage: Parasitizes stem borer egg masses and bug eggs
parasitoids.conservation_practice: Avoid broad-spectrum chemical sprays to protect wasp populations

entomopathogens.target_hosts: Naturally infects and kills planthoppers and leafhoppers in humid conditions
Naturally infects and eliminates leaf folder and armyworm caterpillars
Entomopathogenic fungi controlling insect pests naturally in soil and foliage

dry_weather_conditions.advisory_en: Under dry weather conditions, be especially vigilant for Brown Planthopper, White-backed Planthopper, and Rice Leaf Folder infestations.

wet_weather_conditions.advisory_en: Under wet weather conditions, be especially vigilant for Rice Gall Midge, Rice Leaf Folder, Caseworm, Rice Blast, and Sheath Blight infections.
